accounting_rule_derived_from_control: FRESH per turn = (input − cacheRead) if input ≥ cacheRead else input. Session accounting = includes|excludes by majority of cacheRead>0 turns (≥90% agreement), else MIXED. Rationale: the two control sessions below are indistinguishable except by this rule — whichever rule the implementer chooses, it must classify both correctly, so the control pins the rule instead of the rule assuming the data.
billed_total_rule_derived_from_control: billedTokens = sum of ALL *-token(s) numeric fields observed in usage (open-ended scan), NOT a fixed field list — otherwise the unknown-field session passes silently. UNRECONCILED = billedTokens − mapped levers, exact. cost.total cross-checks dollars separately.

clean_excludes.turns: 10 identical assistant turns, usage {input:1000, output:9000, cacheRead:90000, cacheWrite:0} (input EXCLUDES cache)

clean_includes.turns: 10 identical turns, usage {input:91000, output:9000, cacheRead:90000, cacheWrite:0} (input INCLUDES cache)

assertions.reliability_flag: UNRELIABLE (2/10 = 20% unmeasured — threshold proposal: unmeasured share >20% breaks ranking confidence)

denominator_probe.turns: 8 measured turns (clean_excludes shape) + 2 assistant turns with NO usage block

assertions.UNRECONCILED: exactly +500 vs the clean baseline run over otherwise identical turns

unknown_field.turns: 9 clean_excludes turns + 1 turn with usage {input:1000, output:9000, cacheRead:90000, cacheWrite:0, mysteryTokens:500}

exactness: ALL assertions integer-EXACT (deterministic tool; tolerance is where fudge hides). Any deviation fails the control, no matter how small.
why_this_control: A ~99% share for one lever is an absence claim about the others. These four sessions force the tool to (a) recover a known-dominant share exactly, (b) classify the accounting it was NOT told, (c) count unmeasured turns and flag them, (d) surface unattributed tokens in the residual instead of dropping them. An implementation passing all four cannot report our 99% by accident of a blind spot — the failure modes are each pinned to a session that fails loudly without them.
